**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement imposes no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Clear Capital, satisfying the preferred position of the NONCOMPETE rule.

What I checked and ruled out:
- **§ 13 Non-solicitation (p0047)** — mutual, term plus one year, employee non-solicit only. Not a non-compete, applies equally to both parties, and is governed by a separate rule.
- **§ 4(b)(ii) (p0020)** — the only "Company shall not" restriction; it limits resale/use of the Contractor's own pre-existing proprietary materials. This is IP licence scope, not a restraint on the businesses we operate or the products we buy or build. § 4(c) (p0021) balances it with a royalty-free, perpetual, sublicensable licence for our business operations.
- **§ 4(b) (p0019)** — runs in the Contractor's favour (preserving its freedom to serve other clients). Restrictions benefiting or binding only the vendor are not flagged.
- Sweeps for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "engage in", "similar services", "field of use", "may not", "agrees not to" and "refrain" returned no restriction on our side; the single "compet" hit was "court of competent jurisdiction."

Note for the file: the planner flagged § 2 as unlisted in the outline — it appears as a one-line TERM provision at p0011 within § 1 and contains no covenant language, so there is no hidden restriction there.
